integrity_rules: Official or first-party sources outrank third-party planners.
A source failure is no_data, never no_service or no_route.
Keep publisher timestamps and retrieval timestamps separate.
Do not call web_only sources machine-readable or scrape protected pages.
Do not call registration or api_key sources unless credentials are already configured.
Recheck the selected line and corridor immediately before answering.

profiles.name: Istanbul

sources.license: IBB Open Data Licence applies only to catalogued open-data assets
sources.use: Use the index as city context and spatially match current announcements for corridor checks.
sources.limits: A citywide index is not a route-segment ETA; undocumented schemas may drift.

sources.license: Publisher terms; summarize and link unless an open-data licence is explicit
sources.use: Check exact rail-line service status and update time.
sources.limits: IsActive alone does not prove healthy service; Metro fare is not an all-network total.

sources.license: IBB Open Data Licence for CKAN packages; endpoint terms may differ
sources.use: Use current static bus baseline, alerts, and exact-line vehicle context.
sources.limits: IETT live data is not GTFS-Realtime and vehicle positions are not passenger ETA.

sources.use: Check exact ferry cancellations and Marmaray last-minute notices.
sources.limits: No verified public live vessel or Marmaray train-position feed.

caveats: No verified citywide standard GTFS-Realtime feed covers all modes.
The legacy multi-operator IBB GTFS package is historical and must not be used as current.
Prefer rail when comparable; road-heavy bus ETA needs route-specific traffic evidence.

profiles.name: London

sources.license: Open Government Licence v3 plus TfL attribution and trademark rules
sources.use: Use TfL's current timetable/network feeds as the official baseline.
sources.limits: TfL does not publish one complete citywide GTFS equivalent for every mode.

sources.license: Open Government Licence v3 plus TfL conditions
sources.use: Use arrivals, line status, disruptions, and official journey planning when credentials exist.
sources.limits: Some arrival observations can be stale after roughly 30 seconds; keep timestamps.

sources.use: Validate current corridor incidents, works, and large events.
sources.limits: TfL road coverage is not uniform across every borough road.

caveats: No key means official web checks only for live data.
Always keep TfL source and payload timestamps.

profiles.name: Paris / Ile-de-France

sources.use: Official all-operator baseline with a rolling timetable horizon.
sources.limits: Validate feed horizon and service date on every build.

sources.use: Use next passages and traffic information for covered operators/lines.
sources.limits: Realtime does not cover every line; check the official coverage list.

sources.license: Publisher terms; do not republish live-map content
sources.use: Check live regional traffic and planned Paris street closures.
sources.limits: Summarize and link rather than copying live-map content.

caveats: No realtime record is no_data, not proof of normal service.

profiles.name: Berlin / Brandenburg

sources.use: Use the official VBB schedule baseline.
sources.limits: Retain feed date/hash and validate calendar exceptions.

sources.use: Use as realtime evidence only when fresh and coverage is intact.
sources.limits: Official page reports data loss/incomplete coverage since 2026-06-04; cross-check VBB/operator alerts.

sources.license: Archive datasets may be dl-de/by-2.0; live map terms differ
sources.use: Validate current traffic and closures visually.
sources.limits: Traffic-detection archives are not a live route ETA source.

profiles.name: Dublin

sources.use: Use the national official schedule baseline and record download hash/date.
sources.limits: Automated HEAD may return 403 even when the portal permits download; do not mislabel as no service.

sources.use: Use current predictions/vehicles/alerts when a token is configured.
sources.limits: Poll no more frequently than once per 60 seconds per token.

sources.use: Cross-check line alerts and live road conditions.

caveats: The old TII travel-time XML had a stale 2021 publication time and is excluded from live evidence.

profiles.name: Milan

sources.use: Use the official local schedule baseline.
sources.limits: Refresh cadence varies; validate service dates.

sources.use: Check planned changes and current passenger information.
sources.limits: No verified openly licensed machine-readable GTFS-RT/SIRI feed; do not scrape.

caveats: Treat realtime ETA as unknown unless the official app/page or an accessible planner was checked at query time.

profiles.name: Madrid

sources.license: CRTM LDA; retain metadata and linked Powered by CRTM attribution

sources.limits: Realtime coverage is not citywide.

sources.use: Use only for EMT city-bus realtime when credentials exist.

sources.use: Use current road incidents and corridor controls.
sources.limits: Match incidents spatially; do not apply regional events to every route.

sources.use: Cross-check current train operation.

sources.use: Use official subway/rail schedules and no-key realtime where terms allow.
sources.limits: MTA terms prohibit connecting end users directly to MTA servers; a compliant proxy/cache is required for an app.

sources.use: Use bus realtime only with credentials and compliant serving architecture.
sources.limits: A serverless skill should prefer the MTA passenger page rather than direct end-user API calls.

profiles.name: Chicago

sources.use: Use GTFS-RT with a key or official passenger alerts without one.
